headline: Exact entrywise-dense active-spectrum-{1,1,-1} tetrahedral targets with m-tooth cap-one marginals, no independent uniform convolution factor of any fixed positive width, nevertheless satisfy ||p||_inf ->3sqrt(2). On the same matrices, account02/B17 gives ||p||_inf <=3sqrt(2)+14.51216338024275 epsilon_m^(1/3) for unit-uniform plus momentless Cauchy noise.
